trap.label: concordar
trap.wrong: The examiner did not concord with our amendment.
trap.right: The examiner did not agree with our amendment.
trap.why: Em português “concordar” sugere concord. Em inglês, concord é substantivo/raro; o verbo é agree.

opts: We therefore propose to amend claim 1.

fix.wrong: We respectfully disagree of the examiner.
fix.right: We respectfully disagree with the examiner.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva mais cortês: “You are wrong.” (We respectfully…)
Reescreva com still less: “It does not teach this, and does not suggest it.”
rewrite.answer: It does not teach this, still less suggest it.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com agree: “The examiner did not concord.”
